comfort_per_head._: Decision 652 (the coordinator's ruling on economy's gold and food note: a founding town never sells its stores): a raw good's comfort is the most of comfort's and this times the town's residents.

herder._: Decision 640, economy's side (Jeff: "herders exist as people"): each place keyed one of places (the hills' refuges) gets a herder of its own after growth_days, with start sheep; each spring lambs toward most; every few days, home, the herder walks all but keep to a town with a butchery, away walk_steps, sold at the store's price as far as its treasury pays, and buys food of it for his keep. Drafts, Jeff's to move.

butcher._: Decision 590 (Jeff: the herder, the butcher, the cook, a supply chain): a butchery is built once the flock reaches from; a butcher comes to it after growth_days; each autumn, after the shearing, the shepherd culls the flock to keep of the pasture's room into the store as live sheep; at the manned butchery each steps of work turns one sheep into meat meat and hide hide.

fisherman._: Decision 594 (Jeff: 'town can have fisherman that go to river and back with fish'): a work-site trade (sites.trades fisherman: fishing, a place on the river's bank); every steps he walks there and back and brings catch fish, the season's scale; a newcomer once the town holds a fishing place and has reached stage, after growth_days.

stages._: Decision 591, economy's side (Held's growth): a town rises to the next stage when it meets all of its needs, one step at a time: residents, standing kinds, trades among its residents, gold in the treasury, wood in the store. 649 (Jeff: 'towns start as a settlement with tents'): the settlement first, tents and nothing standing; a town falls back a stage on decline's strain. Drafts, Jeff's to move.
stages.name: settlement

decline._: Decision 649 (Jeff: 'towns be able to regress ... buildings at the edge fall into disrepair and the forest overtakes'): once a day a town at a stage past the first gains a day of strain when it is short of the stage's residents, a needed kind is out of use, more than hungry_share of its residents are hungry and the store's food, meat and fish can't feed them (hunger with food in the store is a purse's), Jeff's list: the people fall, the resources can't keep up, raids and captives (a resident carried off adds captive_strain), and loses one on a day with none; at strain_days it falls a stage. Every upkeep.every days each building pays upkeep.cost times its level from the store (a building row's own upkeep overrides; {} for none), nearest the store first; one owing, damaged, or with none of its trade in town for unkept_days days falls into disrepair, out of use, a level lost each season, then a ruin kept a season and gone, its ground given back to the forest. A new build or raise keeps a round of upkeep in the store (Production.keep_for). Drafts, Jeff's to tune (the first soak, 7 days and a hamlet's wood 20: the wilds' wood went to building and four buildings fell into disrepair by day 28).

sought._: Decision 613 amended (Jeff: newcomers are found, each with their own place and story of how they got there; they wander off when low): a trade's newcomer is sought at its trades row's place (maps' or dungeon's place key; camp: a hostile camp whose freed go home there), held by holder (a faction, "" lost; band enemy-ai's), lore's story; a second time out the alt variant, then in turn. A trade with no row walks in (an interim; the medicine man waits on Jeff). A resident of a trade with a row who is hungry, owed wages or idle for want of stock past leave_days wanders back to their place; one lost on the way is tried again restock_days later. Off until maps sets Towns.place_sought.

founding._: Decision 652 (the coordinator's ruling: start_food reaches the first autumn harvest for the founding headcount; the caravan keeps a month's food a head till the first harvest is in): a town's first stores are the most of start_food and per_head_day x its residents (at least heads, topped up once its people are counted) x the days to the first crop of any kind it can reap, from when its field can stand (field_days on if none stands: the autumn harvest if sown that spring, else the winter's roots; 652 amended); till its first harvest a caravan keeps keep_days x per_head_day food a head. Before 652: start_food 120 and comfort food 20 alone, sold from on day 0. per_head_day 1.5 (was 1; 652 amended's re-soak: a town eats about 1.4 a head a day with its newcomers and its cook's rations).

lawspeaker._: Decision 652 (the coordinator's ruling: the officials come with the stages): each official is paid from its stage (a settlement pays none); appoint: the town names one on reaching it (the lawspeaker; was from 6 residents and a need of the town stage).

robbers._: Decision 580, economy's side: the grave robbers of the barrow level carry gold. Their purse fills once a game day with altar_share of the gold below at every town's altar (the plunder, what angers the old gods in lore) and with thief_cut of each lift a town's thief makes (his fence); a robber of kinds fallen in the barrow drops his share, the purse over those standing, at most most, as whole purse items.

fence._: Decision 586 (Jeff: Snagfin the only fence): the settled resident by is the only buyer of stolen and grave goods: the thief's lifts, and a player's grave goods at his counter (the town's counter nearest his home) by night (dark under the open sky) at factor of the town's price; by day he refuses them and his shop's goods sell at day_markup. Every other counter, maker and the store say won't buy.

care._: Decision 584 amended (Jeff: '5 herbs, 5 antlers or 10 gold to bypass the quest, but doing his 1st quest can open up further quests'): a healer's hut brings back only a player in its care; any one of retainer gold, herbs or antlers handed at his hut puts them in it at once; his first errand (npc's, the five herbs) does too and opens his further errands. sick and word_days are npc's kin errand, at a hut in a town only.

field._: Decision 544: the draugr's blessed brought back where they fell. A blessed body (a player marked draugr, a companion with draugr in her marks) whose player has charges left lies downed window_s seconds at 0 HP; a blessed hand beside it, still and unhit for channel_s, brings it back at hp of its most, one charge off the channeler's player's count; else it dies as ever. Decision 573: the draugr's deals, the gold a player gives buying the highest step it reaches (under the least refused), its charges taken up to the capacity: capacity_step for each step of the hardest deal beaten, and one more for each named container (none yet). The charges are a count on the player's record, no item. Mortally Wounded (Jeff's down screen): every player at 0 HP lies downed, the blessed window_s, the unblessed unblessed_s (last moments, Bleed Out only; nobody brings them back); a downed player's heart beats at heart.beats[0], Slow Heart held steps it down one beat each heart.step_s (released, back up), and their blood runs at heart.drain of the beat's place (1 at 120: the window as it is; less, longer); a revive starts only when it is calm (World.calm).

makes._: Decision 641: what each healer's hut makes, by its place key or else its area; a hut not listed makes _default.
